Subject: Re: [opensuse] [SOLVED]See packages that were updated on a certain day?

The Sunday 2008-02-10 at 15:15 -0500, Chris Arnold wrote:

> Using 10.1 and would like to view all packages that were updated on Sat the 9th. Is there any way to do this?

>rpm -q -a --queryformat "%{INSTALLTIME}\\t%{INSTALLTIME:day} \\
    %{BUILDTIME:day} %-30{NAME}\\t%15{VERSION}-%-7{RELEASE}\\t%{arch} \\
    %25{PACKAGER}\\n" | sort | cut --fields="2-" | less -S


>The first column of the output is the date. Just search or grep.
You 'da man. Thank you!!!
